registry_note: Seed registry of general limitation candidates. Every entry is a routing lead in the pending-verification state: verify the statute and period through the jurisdiction's legislation checker at the assessment date before any reliance. A claim type not listed is 'cannot be determined', never cleared.

general_periods.basis: Competition and Consumer Act 2010 (Cth) sch 2 s 236(2)

special_regimes.flag: No-limitation reforms apply in every jurisdiction; never state a limitation candidate for these claims — flag for the responsible lawyer.

A one-year limitation period from publication applies in every jurisdiction, subject to extension provisions; jurisdiction and publication date drive the candidate. Checked at the 24 September 2026 review: Western Australia has not enacted the Stage 1 uniform defamation reforms (the Defamation Act 2005 (WA) has had no consolidation since 1 January 2006), so the single-publication rule and associated extension changes do not apply there; the Northern Territory has adopted them (Limitation Act 1981 (NT) s 44AAB single publication rule and s 44AA; Defamation Act 2006 (NT) ss 9A, 11A–11B, 26A, via the Defamation Legislation Amendment Act 2025) — confirm the NT commencement date and verify both at use.
Discoverability-based and scheme-specific periods (including motor accident and workers compensation schemes) displace the general period.
Separate contribution periods run from judgment or settlement, not from the underlying wrong.
Survival-of-actions and family-provision periods are separate and short; flag whenever a party has died.
Postponement and suspension provisions may extend any candidate; record as flags, never resolved.
